ai_summary: Aditya Birla Capital Limited announced a Board Meeting on October 30, 2026, to consider and approve its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This regulatory filing provides a key update for investors regarding the upcoming financial performance disclosure, with the trading window for designated persons remaining closed until November 1, 2026, in compliance with insider trading regulations. No red flags are identified, as this is a routine and mandatory corporate announcement.
